name: evb-viewer
author: Eugene Barsky <34789976+evb0110@users.noreply.github.com>
description: EVB Viewer - a PDF and DjVu document viewer

scripts.start: pnpm run build:electron && tsx scripts/electronRun.ts start
scripts.dev:headless: pnpm run electron:run:headless -- stop --session=default --keep-nuxt && pnpm run build:electron && pnpm run electron:run:headless -- start
scripts.build: pnpm run generate:build-artifacts && pnpm exec nuxi build && node scripts/prune-build-artifacts.mjs && node scripts/check-web-deploy-assets.mjs
scripts.build:desktop: pnpm run check:wasm:portable && pnpm run build:desktop:no-wasm-check
scripts.build:desktop:no-wasm-check: pnpm run build && pnpm run build:electron && pnpm run build:native
scripts.build:native:e2e: node scripts/validation-gates.mjs heavy --id=native-e2e --weight=1 -- node scripts/build-native-tool.mjs pdf-image-combine scan-cleanup
scripts.build:pdf-image-combine: node scripts/validation-gates.mjs heavy --id=native-pdf-image-combine --weight=1 -- node scripts/build-native-tool.mjs pdf-image-combine
scripts.build:pdf-page-ops: node scripts/validation-gates.mjs heavy --id=native-pdf-page-ops --weight=1 -- node scripts/build-native-tool.mjs pdf-page-ops
scripts.build:pdf-search: node scripts/validation-gates.mjs heavy --id=native-pdf-search --weight=1 -- node scripts/build-native-tool.mjs pdf-search
scripts.build:scan-cleanup: node scripts/validation-gates.mjs heavy --id=native-scan-cleanup --weight=1 -- node scripts/build-native-tool.mjs scan-cleanup
scripts.postinstall: pnpm exec nuxi prepare && pnpm run copy:pdfjs
scripts.typecheck: node scripts/run-nuxt-typecheck.mjs && node scripts/run-workspace-package-typecheck.mjs -p electron/tsconfig.json -p tests/tsconfig.json -p tsconfig.scripts.json -p server/tsconfig.json
scripts.typecheck:clean: node scripts/run-nuxt-typecheck.mjs --cold && node scripts/run-workspace-package-typecheck.mjs --cold -p electron/tsconfig.json -p tests/tsconfig.json -p tsconfig.scripts.json -p server/tsconfig.json
scripts.fallow:all: pnpm run fallow && pnpm run fallow:dupes
scripts.test:coverage: vitest run --coverage --project unit-core --project unit-app --project unit-electron --project unit-scripts --project unit-policy && pnpm exec tsx scripts/checkCoverageRatchet.ts && pnpm exec tsx scripts/checkZeroExecutionCoverage.ts
scripts.test:electron-bundle-static-integrity: pnpm run build:electron && pnpm run test:electron-bundle-static-integrity:no-build && node scripts/prune-build-artifacts.mjs && pnpm run check:build-artifacts:hygiene
scripts.test:unit: node scripts/validation-gates.mjs heavy --id=test-unit --weight=1 -- pnpm exec vitest run --project unit-core --project unit-app --project unit-electron --project unit-scripts --project unit-policy
scripts.lint:rust: cargo fmt --manifest-path native/Cargo.toml --all --check && cargo clippy --manifest-path native/Cargo.toml --workspace --all-targets -- -D warnings
scripts.test:rust: cargo test --manifest-path native/Cargo.toml --workspace --locked && pnpm exec tsx scripts/checkSearchNativeParity.ts
scripts.test:e2e:electron: pnpm run build:native:e2e && pnpm run build:electron && vitest run --project e2e-regression --reporter verbose
scripts.test:e2e:electron:blocking-smoke: pnpm run build:electron && vitest run --project e2e-blocking-smoke --reporter verbose
scripts.test:e2e:electron:draw-shapes: pnpm run build:electron && vitest run --project e2e-draw-shapes --reporter verbose
scripts.test:e2e:electron:large: pnpm run build:pdf-page-ops && EVB_E2E_REQUIRE_LARGE_PDF_FIXTURE=1 pnpm run build:electron && EVB_PDF_PAGE_OPS_ENABLE=1 EVB_E2E_REQUIRE_LARGE_PDF_FIXTURE=1 vitest run --project e2e-large-pdf --reporter verbose
scripts.test:e2e:electron:quarantine: pnpm run build:native:e2e && pnpm run build:electron && vitest run --project e2e-quarantine --passWithNoTests --reporter verbose
scripts.test:e2e:electron:rapid-navigation: pnpm run build:electron && vitest run --project e2e-rapid-navigation --reporter verbose
scripts.test:e2e:electron:visible-window: pnpm run build:electron && vitest run --project e2e-visible-window --reporter verbose
scripts.test:e2e:electron:regression: pnpm run build:native:e2e && pnpm run build:electron && vitest run --project e2e-regression --reporter verbose
scripts.test:e2e:electron:save-pipeline: pnpm run build:pdf-page-ops && pnpm run build:electron && EVB_PDF_PAGE_OPS_ENABLE=1 vitest run --project e2e-save-pipeline tests/e2e/electron/savePipeline.e2e.test.ts --reporter verbose
scripts.diag:pdf-navigation-blink-trace: pnpm run build:electron && pnpm exec tsx scripts/diagnostics/pdfNavigationBlinkTrace.ts
scripts.diag:pdf-skeleton-navigation: pnpm run build:electron && pnpm exec tsx scripts/diagnostics/runPdfSkeletonNavigationDiagnostics.ts
scripts.diag:arnold-pdf-open: pnpm run build:electron && pnpm exec tsx scripts/diagnostics/runArnoldPdfOpenDiagnostics.ts
scripts.diag:pdf-tabs:ci: sh -c 'pnpm electron:run stop --session=pdf-tabs-ci >/dev/null 2>&1 || true; pnpm run build:electron && pnpm electron:run startd --session=pdf-tabs-ci && pnpm diag:pdf-tabs --session pdf-tabs-ci --tabs 4 --cycles 3 --gc --sample-heap --max-inactive-canvases 0 --max-inactive-rendered-pages 0 --max-inactive-djvu-images 0 --max-inactive-canvas-pixels 0; status=$?; pnpm electron:run stop --session=pdf-tabs-ci >/dev/null 2>&1 || true; exit $status'
scripts.check:architecture: node scripts/architecture/boundary-check.mjs --scope=focused && pnpm exec eslint app electron packages scripts server tests eslint-plugin-custom.mjs vitest.config.ts vitest.shared.config.ts --max-warnings=0 --report-unused-disable-directives
